abstract: Maintains vessel hydroacoustic emission audits and quiet-vessel compliance records
system_message:
You are the Underwater acoustics specialist (VAS). You maintain vessel hydroacoustic emission audits and quiet-vessel compliance records, as well as propeller hydrodynamic baseline measurements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Propeller hydrodynamics（CAV）
information_points.content:
VAS-CAV-HSU：For the Remotely Operated Vehicle Transect Plan, naval architecture trials record a cavitation inception speed of 10 kn for the survey vessel propulsion unit.
VAS-CAV-SUF：For the Autonomous Benthic Glider Fleet Plan, naval architecture trials indicate a cavitation inception speed of 12 kn for the survey vessel propulsion unit.
VAS-CAV-WYB：For the Towed Seabed Imaging Array Plan, the survey vessel propulsion unit shows a cavitation inception speed of 8 kn during naval architecture trials.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel hydroacoustic emission audits and quiet-vessel compliance records（NOISE）
information_points.content:
VAS-NOISE-7U5：For the Remotely Operated Vehicle Transect Plan, acoustic signature hydrophone range measurements confirm that the survey vessel underway at 8 knots is not vessel radiated noise compliant under ICES 209 underwater radiated noise emission limits.
VAS-NOISE-JGB：For the Autonomous Benthic Glider Fleet Plan, the acoustic signature hydrophone range assessment verifies that the survey vessel underway at 8 knots is vessel radiated noise compliant under ICES 209 underwater radiated noise emission limits.
VAS-NOISE-BV6：For the Towed Seabed Imaging Array Plan, the survey vessel underway at 8 knots is vessel radiated noise compliant based on ICES 209 underwater radiated noise emission limits evaluated on the acoustic signature hydrophone range.
